pages.description: After binding the  Handy Haversack to a  container, you can  right-click items  onto the haversack  to deposit them into  that container from  anywhere. When the  container is  unloaded the  haversack will close  and not accept any  items. You can  automate the  depositing of items  by adding items to  its filters. Use the
haversack with an  item in your off  hand, or scribe the  haversack using a  Scribe's table with  the item you wish to  add.
